szoveg_eredeti:
Cory Weinberg / New York Times :

 S-1: Nvidia plans to invest about $10B in Anthropic after its IPO, or ~10% of the new cash Anthropic is expected to raise this month, including in the IPO   —  Nvidia planned to invest $10 billion in Anthropic alongside its initial public offering, the largest of the new financial commitments from several giants to the A.I. company.
